text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Brown short-sleeve button shirt with large pale patterned pointed collar; taupe high-waist pleated wide-leg trousers with long button fly and attached narrow fabric waist ties; taupe shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A fine silver chain necklace with tiny pendant, complete closed chain loop.; A medium dark brown soft leather handbag with two short rounded handles and slightly slouchy body.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Brown short-sleeve button shirt with large pale patterned pointed collar; taupe high-waist pleated wide-leg trousers with long button fly and attached narrow fabric waist ties; taupe shoes.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: A fine silver chain necklace with tiny pendant, complete closed chain loop.; A medium dark brown soft leather handbag with two short rounded handles and slightly slouchy body.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
